source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide whether a relationship should be treated as direct proportion or inverse proportion before calculating the missing value.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Inverse proportion is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide whether a relationship should be treated as direct proportion' is answered as inverse proportion rather than direct proportion.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: direct proportion still holds here even though A direct-proportion setup is appropriate when the quantities increase or decrease together is missing from the stem — on the item about Decide whether a relationship should be treated as.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Inverse proportion is what produces direct proportion, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide whether a relationship should be treated as.

intelligence.enrichment: In direct proportion, corresponding quantities change in the same proportional way; in inverse proportion, the quantities change in opposite directions and satisfy x * y = k for a constant k.
